data.text: For details about the transition of participants from Study Period 1 to Study Period 2, see the schema (Section 1.2) and the relevant notes in the SoA for Study Period 2 (Section 1.3.2).
data.sourceSection: 1.3.1 Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1

data.text: *DXA scan must be completed at or within 7 days after V2. If rescan is needed and performed outside the 7 days, this will not be a protocol deviation.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.1 Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 - DXA scan row

data.text: AE collection should occur prior to the collection of the C-SSRS. Adapted for the assessment of ideation and behavior categories only.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.1 Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 - C-SSRS row

data.text: The daily eDiary will be applicable only to Study Period 1 and ED, if ED occurs in Study Period 1.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.1 Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 - Participant daily diary row

data.text: *At baseline, collect diary from participants who were not eligible for randomization (screen failed).
data.sourceSection: 1.3.1 Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 - Return daily eDiary row

data.text: In addition to the fasting visits for lipids testing, site personnel can make fasting recommendations per local guidelines for the procedures.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.1 Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 - Laboratory tests section

data.text: For IOCBP only (see Sections 8.2.6 and 10.4.1 of the IIBD master protocol).
data.sourceSection: 1.3.1 Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 - Serum pregnancy row

data.text: For IOCBP, 'negative' test required prior to dosing at marked visits. In Study Period 1, urine pregnancy tests will be done on site only. Additional pregnancy tests (urine or serum) should be performed at any time during the study if a menstrual period is missed, or there is clinical suspicion of pregnancy, or as required by local law or regulation.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.1 Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 - Urine pregnancy row

data.text: *Optional; perform as needed to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals AFAB.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.1 Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 - FSH row

data.text: Screening includes HBsAg and anti-HBc. If HBsAg is negative and anti-HBc is positive, further testing for HBV DNA is required.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.1 Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 - HBV screening row

data.text: For participants who are anti-HBc positive at screening.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.1 Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 - HBV DNA row

data.text: If HCV Ab test is positive, perform HCV RNA test.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.1 Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 - HCV screening row

data.text: Participants who had a TST will return 48 to 72 hours after placement to have their test results read. PPD test does not need to be read at the site but must be read by a trained medical professional, and the result must be presented to the site personnel prior to participant's randomization.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.1 Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 - TB Test row

data.text: For details about the transition of participants from Study Period 1 to Study Period 2, see the schema (Section 1.2). Participants who received LY/mirikizumab co-administration or mirikizumab in Study Period 1 and who are considered responders at Week 12 of Study Period 1 will receive mirikizumab SC starting at Week 0 of Study Period 2.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.2 Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2

data.text: For responders to mirikizumab or LY/mirikizumab co-administration treatment, Visit 6 and Visit 7 will occur on the same day and the Visit 6 procedures are not repeated at Visit 7 (excluding 'Register visit with IWRS').
data.sourceSection: 1.3.2 Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2

data.text: Visit 8 and Visit 10 of the IIBD master protocol SoA do not apply to this ISA.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.2 Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2

data.text: † V7 will be conducted on same day as V6
data.sourceSection: 1.3.2 Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 - SoA Table 2

data.text: Perform as shown in this schedule and as needed at any visit based on participant status and standard of care. Includes examination of eyes, throat, heart, lungs, abdomen, and visual examination of the skin. May be performed by qualified personnel per local regulations. Assess for TB risk factors and for signs and symptoms of active TB, including an assessment of peripheral lymph nodes.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.2 Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 - Symptom-directed physical assessment row

data.text: For IOCBP, 'negative' test required prior to dosing at marked visits. In Study Period 2, urine pregnancy tests can be done on-site or at home. Additional pregnancy tests (urine or serum) should be performed at any time during the study if a menstrual period is missed, or there is clinical suspicion of pregnancy or as required by local law or regulation.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.2 Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 - Urine pregnancy row

data.text: *Optional per investigator's discretion; perform as needed to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals AFAB.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.2 Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 - FSH row

data.text: *Additional C. difficile testing is allowed throughout the study at the investigator's discretion.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.2 Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 - C. difficile testing row

data.text: Other local stool testing, for example, for ova and parasites, is allowed at the investigator's discretion. *Additional stool culture testing is allowed throughout the study at the investigator's discretion.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.2 Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 - Stool culture row

data.text: *Repeat as needed. See Section 6.1.4.1 for mirikizumab injection training details.
data.sourceSection: 1.3.2 Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 - Injection training row

data.description: ISA 1 (J6Z-MC-CD01) for LY4395089 in Crohn's Disease - Initial Protocol. A Phase 2, Multicenter, Randomized, Open-Label, Active-Controlled Study to Investigate LY4395089/Mirikizumab Co-administration Compared with Mirikizumab in Adults with Moderately to Severely Active Crohn's Disease. Electronically signed and approved by Lilly on 18 Dec 2025 GMT. Document ID: VV-CLIN-211806. IND: 178821. EU trial number: 2025-524112-11-00.
